title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to use Page.SetSelectionFilter Method in temporary records
summary: Page.SetSelectionFilter marks user-selected records but doesn't work directly with temporary records without additional setup. The post demonstrates two approaches: manually transferring data from source records to temporary records, or using Record.Copy with the ShareTable parameter set to true when both records are temporary.
key_points: Page.SetSelectionFilter notes user selections and filters to marked records only, but temporary records need data assigned beforehand
For normal source tables, retrieve data using FindSet and TransferFields to populate temporary records before applying SetSelectionFilter
For pages with temporary source tables, use Record.Copy with ShareTable set to true to reference the same table and apply SetSelectionFilter
The ShareTable parameter in Record.Copy can only be true when both records are temporary

quotes.text: Page.SetSelectionFilter(var Record) is a very commonly used method, which can get the value currently selected by the user.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core purpose of the method that developers need to understand

quotes.text: If the variable is temporary, the value will not be obtained. Because we did not assign values to this temporary table in advance.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the key problem that developers encounter when working with temporary records

quotes.text: If FromRecord and Record are both temporary and ShareTable is true, then the COPY method causes Record to reference the same table as FromRecord.
